---
title: "PaCMAP - CD4"
format: html
---


```{r}
library(flowWorkspace)
library(Luciernaga)
library(Coereba)
library(flowGate)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(purrr)
```

```{r}
TheseScripts <- list.files("R", pattern=".R", full.names=TRUE)
walk(.x=TheseScripts, .f=source)
```

```{r}
Folder <- "PMA_Antibody"
Subset <- "CD4"

StorageLocation <- file.path("outputs", Folder, Subset)
DownsampledFolder <- file.path(StorageLocation, "Downsampled")
if (!dir.exists(DownsampledFolder)){dir.create(DownsampledFolder)}

CoerebaFolder <- file.path(StorageLocation, "Coereba")
if (!dir.exists(CoerebaFolder)){dir.create(CoerebaFolder)}

OutputLocation <- CoerebaFolder
```

```{r}
GoodbyeFileName <- paste0("CoerebaConcatenate_", Subset)

PaCMAPName <- paste0(GoodbyeFileName, "_PaCMAP")

ThePACMAPFile <- file.path(OutputLocation, paste0(PaCMAPName, ".fcs"))
PACMAP_cf <- load_cytoset_from_fcs(ThePACMAPFile, truncate_max_range = FALSE, transformation=FALSE)
PACMAP_GS <- GatingSet(PACMAP_cf)
```

```{r}
#| label: "Biexponential Transformation"
#| message: false
Markers <- colnames(PACMAP_GS)
KeptMarkers <- Markers[-grep("Time|FS|SC|SS|Original|-W$|-H$|AF|Coereba|PaCMAP", Markers)]
MarkersForToday <- KeptMarkers

Biexponential <- flowjo_biexp_trans(channelRange=4096, maxValue=4194304,
     pos=5.62, neg=1, widthBasis=-1000)
TransformList <- transformerList(KeptMarkers, Biexponential)

PACMAP_GS <- transform(PACMAP_GS, TransformList)
colnames(PACMAP_GS)
```

```{r}
ggcyto(PACMAP_GS[1], subset="root",
 aes(x="BV480-A", y="PE-Vio770-A")) + geom_hex(bins=100)

ggcyto(PACMAP_GS[1], subset="root",
 aes(x="PaCMAP_1", y="PaCMAP_2")) + geom_hex(bins=180)
```

```{r}
PaCMAPPath <- file.path(StorageLocation, "PaCMAP")
if(!dir.exists(PaCMAPPath)){dir.create(PaCMAPPath)}

PacMAPGS <- paste0(PaCMAPName, ".gs")
SavePaCMAPHere <- file.path(PaCMAPPath, PacMAPGS)
```

```{r}
#| eval: FALSE
save_gs(PACMAP_GS, SavePaCMAPHere)
```

```{r}
plot(PACMAP_GS)
```

```{r}
TheIslands <- gsub("/", "", gs_get_pop_paths(PACMAP_GS))
TheIslands <- TheIslands[!stringr::str_detect(TheIslands, "root")]

AllDNsPMA <- purrr::map2(
  .x = TheIslands,
  .y = TheIslands, 
  .f = ~ Renaming(
    gs              = PACMAP_GS,
    subset          = .x,
    rename_sufix    = .y,
    DownsampleCount = 10000000,
    rename_prefix   = Subset,
    returnType      = "fcs",
    StorageLocation = PaCMAPPath
  )
)
```
